violations.text: Hot dogs were observed held at 50 degrees Fahrenheit. The ambient temperature of the refrigeration unit was observed at 56 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Per PIC, foods were kept in the unit overnight. Person in charge voluntarily disposed of food at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2026

The front mini cooler was observed in poor repair (maintaining ambient temperature above 41 degrees Fahrenheit). The unit is to not be used to hold any TCS foods. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2026
The door to the toilet room in the ware-washing area is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 05/29/2024
